messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV-2 — ErrTracker ingestion downstream errors detected (rate spike + 5xxs). Paging on-call for incidents.

pagerduty: @morgan you have been paged for SEV-2: ErrTracker ingestion errors (see thread).

morgan: seeing lots of gaps in error events in the dashboard. exception count down ~80% for last 15m but raw logs show app errors continuing.

ashok: confirming. Our app-level logs (stdout) show 500s from errtracker api at ~13:02 UTC. We still get tracer spans, but exception events are missing.

morgan: triage — suspect ingestion pipeline at vendor side. Is this affecting alerts?

support-ops: yes — several customer-facing alerts are suppressed because they rely on ErrTracker signals. Not yet SLO breach but some paging suppressed.

ashok: attaching snippet from curl test:
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "ingest temporarily unavailable" }
```

morgan: thanks. routing: @tanvi can you confirm if our fallback logging to internal store is working? we should ensure we capture errors until vendor recovery.

tanvi: verified. fallback logger (internal-error-bucket) is receiving ~95% of events. A small parsing mismatch for python exceptions, but payloads exist. I can spin up a short shim to reformat and bulk ingest into our internal alerts.

sre-lead: good. two-prong: 1) vendor comms / escalation; 2) internal mitigation to preserve customer-facing alerts.

morgan: assigning roles: @ashok vendor comms + status tracking; @tanvi mitigation + replay fix; @sre-lead run impact assessment and coordinate on-call handoff at 13:20 UTC.

ashok: reaching out to ErrTracker support now — escalation request posted, ref INC-173210. pinged vendor oncall.

vendor-oncall: (external) we are aware of a partial ingestion degradation in us-east-1 impacting exception ingestion. investigating gateway autoscaling. initial rollback of recent deploy in progress. ETA 15-30m.

morgan: copy. are they returning 502 or 504? we got 502s earlier.

ashok: vendor says upstream LB overload causing 502 + dropped messages. they mention slow DB writes.

support-ops: flagged customers impacted (IDs: C-442, C-511, C-899) — outreach message drafted. No widespread customer-visible downtime yet; missing error signals could delay investigation.

tanvi: pushing quick parser shim: small aws lambda to take fallback logs and emit standard alert POSTs to our internal alerting endpoint. prepping change now.

morgan: if lambda works, we can restore alerts while vendor recovers. any risk of duplicate alerts once vendor resumes?

tanvi: we will include dedupe header `X-Redwood-Dedup: fallback` and our alerting will ignore duplicates from vendor when ingestion resumes for those event ids. plan: dedupe window 30m.

eng-ml: quick note — ML eval pipeline uses ErrTracker events for quality regressions. those evals might show false stability. mark eval runs as partial for last 2 hours.

sre-lead: noted. adding eval mark to infra runbook.

ashok: vendor update: rollback complete. LB draining. ingest errors dropping sharply. monitoring for backfill success.

vendor-oncall: backfill job submitted; we will reingest queued payloads over next hour. Some payloads might be lost for clients that hit transient 5xx.

morgan: thanks. two tasks: 1) keep fallback running until we see consistent vendor success 2) notify customers that some events may be incomplete and that we're monitoring for backfill.

support-ops: customer notices posted to status page draft: "We observed partial degradation in our third-party error ingestion provider which caused some exception events to be delayed or not recorded. We are monitoring re-ingestion and will follow up if we detect missing data for your account."

tanvi: lambda deployed in canary for 10m now. sending simulated events to validate schema. logs look good.

morgan: handoff — @sre-lead you take next 30m. I'll stay on until the backfill completes or we confirm no more missing signals.

sre-lead: on it. monitoring: dashboard link https://app.redwood.tools/dash/err-ingest . setting alert to notify if exception count remains < 60% of baseline for >10m.

ashok: vendor status: backfill at 40% queued items; ingest 2000/s. they estimate backlog cleared in ~40m.

vendor-oncall: note: some clients will not have retried due to client-side retries being disabled; we recommend customers with missing data trigger manual replays.

support-ops: preparing customer outreach templates for targeted accounts.

morgan: summary for incident log: "ErrTracker ingestion degradation (vendor LB overload) caused missing exception signals for ~18m window; internal fallback captured ~95% of events; temporary lambda shim restored internal alerting; vendor in-progress backfill; customer notices drafted."

sre-lead: closing notes: please attach any replay artifacts and timeline. I'll convert this thread to postmortem draft once the backfill is complete. If any customer reports missing data after 1h post-backfill, reopen incident.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status -> monitoring. Assigned -> sre-lead.

morgan: thanks everyone. react :white_check_mark: and I'll drop a short summary to #postmortems after closure.
